title: DigitalHumanities MuseumProvenanceMerge

stats.done_summary: Successfully completed the Digital Humanities Museum Provenance Merge task. Merged two museum export files (museum_export_a.csv and museum_export_b.csv) into a deduplicated catalog. Key findings: (1) 100% overlap between the two exports - both contained the same object (X-100/X100, a Han Dynasty vase from 200 BCE); (2) Successfully normalized accession numbers to identify duplicates despite formatting differences; (3) Extracted temporal information from textual notes using pattern matching. Deliverables include: merged catalog (outputs/merged_catalog.csv), analysis code (code/provenance_merge.py, code/visualize.py), 4 visualization figures (report/images/), and comprehensive research report (report/report.md).
